activity.notes: Venustiano Carranza Garza entered constitutional presidential office on 1 May 1917 after Mexico's 1917 Constitution and remained incumbent until assassinated at Tlaxcalantongo on 21 May 1920. This is distinct from his preceding 1914–1917 Constitutionalist First Chief/executive authority activity. It refers to existing Mexico, not a separate sovereign Carranza polity.

sources.citation_text: Mexico's National Institute of Anthropology and History identifies Carranza's constitutional presidency in 1917–1920 and records his assassination on 21 May 1920.
